metadata.case_name: YEUNG KWOK WO v. HOI HING STEEL FIXING WORKS CO AND OTHERS

source: He suffered multiple left lower ribs fracture with a splenic rupture.
He suffered multiple left lower ribs fracture with a splenic rupture.
Emergency laparotomy and splenectomy were performed.
He also suffers from a hypertrophic laparotomy scar which required regular kenacort injections for about a year and a hospital admission in 2003 for excision of the scar.
He suffers from tightness at the laparotomy scar, and continues to required to wear a pressure garment.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

source: The plaintiff suffered from abdominal complications following the laparotomy. He was admitted to hospital twice in 2003 with post-laparotomy adhesive obstruction.
He still had persistent symptoms suggesting difficulty in the intestinal transit. These might be due to adhesions or kinking of intestinal loops after the first operation.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of small intestine

manifestations.description: Pain and tenderness at the site of the injury and in the left shoulder and neck
Tightness at the laparotomy scar and requirement to wear a pressure garment
Ongoing bowel problems / difficulty in intestinal transit preventing a normal solid diet

treatments_received: Kenacort injections for scar (about a year)
Excision of hypertrophic laparotomy scar (hospital admission 2003)
Hospital admissions for post-laparotomy adhesive intestinal obstruction (2003)
Use of a pressure garment over the scar

losses.description: Unable to return to work as a steel bender; can work only as watchman/cleaner etc
Loss of spleen following splenic rupture and splenectomy
Hypertrophic laparotomy scar requiring excision and pressure garment

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Reduced sexual ability associated with pain and discomfort

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: Unable to take a normal solid diet because of intestinal symptoms
